claim: Native Windows preprocessing of archive_read_data_into_fd.c rejects the new two-argument fcntl call.
method: Clang dependency preprocessing (-M -MG -nostdinc) on the exact two source trees, repository Windows host configuration and target-provided int size. Missing SDK header bodies are skipped. No full Windows compile or link was performed.
diagnostic: archive_read_data_into_fd.c:119 calls fcntl(fd, F_GETFL); archive_windows.h:92 defines fcntl(fd, cmd, flg). Both macros come from the real selected libarchive header. Both baselines passed and both subjects failed exclusively at this invocation.
